items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: But there were two brothers, Dajon and Joe. Both of them would play trumpet at Laplace.

ctx.x: Is he related to Harold Dajon, the clarinet and saxophone player? You know the saxophone player Harold Dajon from his?
Oh, yeah, I know this one. But there was no can. No can. No can. But there were two brothers, Dajon and Joe. Both of them would play trumpet at Laplace. And they would help you play on your bass?
Yeah, on the band, you know.
